item.title: 盘屿 0.9.6
item.description:
盘屿 0.9.6
· 修复升级后后台组件恢复请求可能被状态检查忽略的问题。 · 首次使用引导不再一直转圈，等待超时或连接失败时会显示检查和重试提示。 · 后台组件暂时无法连接时，仍可检查和获取软件更新。
对应源码：https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.6-78-source.tar.gz

Volisle 0.9.6
· Fix background component restoration being skipped during a concurrent status check after an update. · Replace indefinite setup spinners with guidance when waiting times out or the connection fails. · Keep software updates available when the background component is temporarily disconnected.
Source code: https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.6-78-source.tar.gz
